note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: segments: an escaped \> or \< before & or | is read as a redirection operator, so true \>& git commit … and true \>| git merge … hide a real segment (codex; confirmed)
wrappers: env accepts non-identifier assignment names (X-Y=1, 1X=1) that the shell-assignment regex stops at, hiding the command (codex; confirmed)
landing/merge gates: the ordinary remote-tracking shorthand origin/karta/x/integration is not recognised though refs/remotes/origin/… is (codex; confirmed)
findings_refuted_or_deferred: claude timed out at 900s; kimi returned an empty response (39 tokens); qwen hit its length cap — only antigravity (merge, full-file read) and codex (revise) carried verdicts this round
rounds.notes: Round 5 of the landing review, at tip 9381387. Fixes land as fix/review-ledger-landing-round5; round 6 keys on the new tip and is the closing round: whatever it says is recorded and the branch is handed to the human with the residual list.
